text:
tablet_felix: Highly volatile. Moves between living, bedroom, and kitchen. Do not rely on time-of-day; check the most recent known location. Prioritize coffee_table_l1 for morning/afternoon and bed_b1 for late night.

water_bottle_felix: Inconsistent. Moves between living and kitchen table. Day 22 19:12 feedback confirmed kitchen_table_k1, contradicting my guess of coffee_table_l1. It seems to prefer the kitchen table in the evening. Check kitchen_table_k1 for late evening; coffee_table_l1 for early morning.

charger_felix: Inconsistent. Stays in the living room during the day. Day 23 11:03 feedback confirmed coffee_table_l1, contradicting my guess of desk_b1. It does not go to the bedroom. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day and afternoon locations.

mug_felix: Moves between living and kitchen. Day 21 08:17 feedback showed coffee_table_l1, contradicting my guess of kitchen_table_k1. It seems to prefer the living room in the morning. Check coffee_table_l1 for morning and other times; kitchen_table_k1 only if recently moved.

book_felix: Inconsistent. Day 21 22:38 feedback showed bed_b1, but Day 22 11:14 and Day 23 18:06 feedback showed coffee_table_l1, contradicting my guesses of nightstand_b1 and couch_l1. It does not stay in the bedroom during the day or on the couch in the evening. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day, afternoon, and evening; bed_b1 only for late-night locations.

razor_felix: Inconsistent. Moves between shelf, cabinet, and sink. Day 23 07:00 feedback showed medicine_cabinet_ba1, contradicting my guess of bathroom_shelf_ba1. Check medicine_cabinet_ba1 first in the morning.

glass_felix: Inconsistent. Day 21 22:59 and Day 23 21:35 feedback showed cupboard_k1, contradicting my guesses of nightstand_b1 and kitchen_table_k1. It does not always go to the bedroom at night and is not on the kitchen table in the evening. Check cupboard_k1 for late-night and evening locations.
